blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Grand Lotto 6/55 and Mega Lotto 6/45 jackpots totaling P80.13 million were not won in the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) draws on Monday, Nov. 23, 2026. No bettor picked the winning number combination of 34-48-04-49-22-08 for the Grand Lotto 6/55, with a jackpot of P45 million. This was according to the PCSO results.
